sentences.en: I just discovered this website and I think it's fantastic!

sentences.en: I like the Terminator films because the special effects are fantastic.

sentences.en: Clovis, the constantly jumping wino, has prominent quadriceps and fantastic glutes.
sentences.zh: Clovis 这个不停跳跃的酒鬼，大腿和臀部都非常发达。
